title: Standard Deviation
text: Standard deviation of input or sequence of inputs, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Reset port} sets Reset event; {Running standard deviation} sets the option to select running standard, {Find the standard deviation value over} sets the dimension over which the block computes the standard deviation Each, {Dimension} sets the custom dimension and {Input processing} sets the method to process the input in running mode Columns. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: Data input vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Standard deviation along the specified dimension scalar | vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Running standard deviation
params.values: Option to select running standard deviation off (default) | on

params.name: Find the standard deviation value over
params.values: Dimension over which the block computes the standard deviation Each column (default) | Entire input | Each row | Specified dimension

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Method to process the input in running mode Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Reset port
params.values: Reset event None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample
